newsSince: -5.3% since prior, +20.7% YTD. Mitsubishi Electric shipped 5th-gen SiC-MOSFET bare-die samples, co-developed a new standard power-module package (3-level circuits) with Semikron Danfoss (Jun 8), will launch a free PCS design-data service on Jun 28, opened a Boston DX hub, and added an AI-robotics collaboration; FY27 guidance targets ¥6,200B revenue / ¥475B net profit. Incrementally constructive on power-electronics/automation, but mostly pre-June-9 or modest.
